column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule overrides for Darasa-Core.
# Every override below was added only after a real baseline scan run
# (see docs/security/ZAP_DAST_STRATEGY.md), never speculatively. Do not add
# an IGNORE line to make a real finding disappear without first fixing it or
# explicitly accepting the underlying risk in
# `Cache-Control: no-store` on every non-admin/static/media response. ZAP's
# rule flags non-storable content informationally to prompt a human check
# that this was intentional, not a caching misconfiguration — it was
# intentional (see the ADR-style comment in core/middleware.py), so this is
# a confirmed false positive, not a suppressed real finding.
